scope: Last300 commits reachable from fixed snapshot, not current production and not a live deployment history; path mapping only counts pages eligible in the final snapshot and can miss deleted/renamed historical pages.

hourlyEstimate.note: UTC hour buckets, not exact production build intervals; first and last buckets may be partial. Re-rendered shared metadata can dirty more pages than this direct source-path estimate.

appendOnlyCheck.scope: Last1000 reachable commits at fixed content snapshot; all Markdown except working subtitle directories, not exactly current index eligibility.
